pages.text: $(li)Avoid automating Bewitchment if you can—it’s buggy, and conduit setups often overflow fuel/jars into input slots.$(li)Rock Crusher: use Granite (not Andesite) for Crushed Villiaumite, then Sodium Fluoride via the Fluid Enricher.
$(li)To move Red Matter/Dark Matter Furnaces before you have a Red Matter Pickaxe, use a Bag of Holding, and rotate them with a Crescent Hammer.
